title: Bridge NVENC probe to descriptor cache
summary: Bridge the legacy Test-NvencAvailable startup probe through the descriptor-backed capability probe cache while preserving the legacy NVENC cache surface used by Do-Encode.
reason: Phase 6 requires hardware readiness checks to be descriptor-owned before dormant hardware families are activated. The legacy NVENC probe still duplicated list/runtime probing and cached by a single global result instead of the configured probe encoder.
behavior_before: Test-NvencAvailable owned a separate NVENC list/runtime probe implementation and reused $script:NvencAvailableProbe without descriptor-backed cache-key evidence for the configured TestEncoder.
behavior_after: Test-NvencAvailable resolves the configured NVENC probe descriptor, delegates list/runtime probing to Test-MediaEncoderDescriptorAvailable, exposes descriptor-backed evidence on $script:NvencAvailableProbe, and avoids reusing a HEVC probe result for a different configured NVENC encoder unless the backend has been explicitly invalidated.
manual_validation: PowerShell parser check for encode_policy.ps1 and Invoke-EncoderCapabilityProbeChecks.ps1 - passed
ops/pipeline/tests/Unit/Invoke-EncoderRuntimeMatrixChecks.ps1 - passed (3 CPU rows executed, 9 hardware rows list-only skipped by default)
ops/pipeline/tests/Invoke-ToolIntegrationChecks.ps1 - passed on rerun after one unrelated ASS-helper transient failure
rollback_plan: Revert the legacy NVENC descriptor-bridge helper functions, restore Test-NvencAvailable's separate list/runtime probe implementation, remove the cache-key regression assertions, revert active-doc wording, and refresh generated summaries.
